name: B10-0424/2026 – Recital K – Am 86
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: K.whereas Islamophobia is a specific form of racism occurring when Muslims or those perceived to be Muslims suffer from discrimination, stigmatisation and exclusion in all areas of life, such as education, employment, vocational training, services and political participation;
